linkedin.text:
You switch from Claude Code to Cursor and suddenly none of your custom skills work. You rebuild them. Two weeks later you try Codex and rebuild them again. Every tool restart means redoing integrations, reconnecting services, and rewriting the same workflows.

🚨 That's hours of duplicate work that should happen once.

OpenWork solves it with one MCP server. You connect it to any compatible agent and your entire workflow follows you — skills, plugins, MCPs, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 connections, everything.

✅ Install one MCP and every agent sees your capabilities
✅ Share workflows across teammates without rebuilding
✅ Admin controls for teams managing models and access at scale

Over 20,000 developers use it as the open-source alternative to Claude Cowork. It runs on Mac, Windows, and Linux and works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, and any MCP-compatible agent.

🛠️ Search GitHub for "different-ai/openwork" and check the README.

Have you tried syncing agent workflows across multiple tools?
